stories.headline: Russian missiles and drone crash in Poland during mass attack on Ukraine
stories.summary: Poland says two Russian Kh-101 cruise missiles and a jet-powered drone fell on its territory overnight during Russian strikes on Ukraine, activating air defences. Tusk says the incursion looks deliberate rather than accidental and coincided with Western exercises in the region. Polish authorities are investigating, and Kyiv is cooperating and has voiced solidarity.
stories.turkey: Russian weapons falling on a NATO member's soil tests Alliance deterrence and Black Sea and eastern-flank security, which matter to Ankara as a NATO member.

stories.headline: Russia launches one of its largest air attacks, hitting Kyiv bridges and power grid
stories.summary: Russia fired roughly 84-110 missiles, including ballistic and Kalibr types, and about 400 drones at energy sites, Kyiv's Dnipro bridges and border crossings. At least eight people were killed, power cuts hit Kyiv and ten oblasts, and nuclear plants cut output. Ukraine says air defence downed most missiles and that it hit three Russian ballistic launchers. Zelensky is pressing for PAC-2 and PAC-3 interceptors.
stories.turkey: The escalation against Ukrainian energy and Dnipro crossings raises Black Sea and regional risk and weighs on Türkiye's mediation role.

stories.summary: Two or more oil tankers caught fire after hitting mines in the eastern Strait of Hormuz. The IRGC Navy says the vessels carried over 4 million barrels, and Iran warned ships not to transit without coordination. A maritime watchdog reports a burning LPG tanker and armed skiffs, and a US source says Iran is using more lethal missiles against shipping.

Kyiv and Paris said five European nations, the EU and NATO will join negotiation formats.

A deal brokered by Shiite leaders reportedly averted a clash, with Qaani said to have held talks with the militia. A command centre has opened, and Zaidi calls it the start of extending state authority.

The Houthis claimed strikes on four sites and told foreign investors to leave. Saudi air defences intercepted other missiles and drones, the GCC, Arab League and Syria condemned the attack, and the US urged citizens to be on high alert. stories.headline: IRGC touts missile reach and readiness as Iran faces IAEA pressure
stories.summary: An IRGC official claimed Iran demonstrated missiles with 4,500 km range near Diego Garcia. Other IRGC officers said air defences are upgraded and missiles can be redeployed. Iran said it will not accept unrestricted IAEA inspections under military threats.
stories.turkey: Longer-range Iranian missiles and the nuclear dispute raise regional deterrence risks near Türkiye.
